subject: Prompt footprint purge request — next steps and evidence
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finexa.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Finexa Legal <legal@finexa.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge prompt footprints + generated outputs for tenant finexa-eu-3

Hi Maya,

We need to submit a formal erasure request for tenant finexa-eu-3. Scope: all user prompts, assistant outputs, and the derived logs (request/response traces, KV cache entries) tied to that tenant. This is a regulatory-driven request from our data protection officer — they want confirmation that artifacts are removed from production storage, caches, and any opaque model-derived logs.

Please confirm:
- The expected timeline for complete removal and evidence delivery.
- What we'll receive as proof (audit manifest, hashes, timestamps).
- Any things that cannot be irreversibly deleted (if applicable).

Attached: signed-erasure-request.pdf (signed by Finexa DPO).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Senior Engineering Manager, Finexa Health

Attachments: signed-erasure-request.pdf
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finexa.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge prompt footprints + generated outputs for tenant finexa-eu-3

Hi Tom — thanks for the note and the signed request, I've routed this into our erasure intake process. A few quick clarifications so we scope the work correctly:

1) Tenant identifiers: please confirm that "finexa-eu-3" is the only tenant identifier we should target (no related aliases or staging tenants).
2) Retention windows: do you want us to remove only artifacts generated after a given date, or do you want a full historical purge?
3) Legal contact: include a primary legal contact for any attestations/doc-signing we may need to produce.

Our expected plan (high level): intake -> ticket -> scheduled purge job (KV cache + blob store sweep) -> run ephemeral purge payload -> generate erasure-manifest (timestamps + retained hashes removed) -> deliver evidence bundle. Typical completion window for full-scope purges in EU is 48–72 hours after intake acceptance, barring any queued maintenance windows.

I've attached our erasure intake template to capture the details we need to proceed. Once you confirm the three items above I will kick off the internal runbook and loop in infra.

-Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: erasure-intake-template.xlsx
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACTION: ERASE-457 intake confirmed for finexa-eu-3 (need infra + ops execution)

Team — Finexa DPO submitted a signed request. They confirmed full-tenant purge (no date filter) — related ticket ERASE-457. Scope: prompts, generated outputs, request/response traces, KV cache entries, and any transient model-layer artifacts. Region: EU (data in eu-west-1).

Proposed runbook (short):
- Karthik: please validate data residency and enumerate storage locations (blob buckets, indexed logs, and any feature stores that materialize prompts).
- Marcus: schedule a k8s job to run purge-worker against bucket prefixes and our internal trace-store; ensure we use the deletion API to produce tombstone records. We should also rotate/flush any in-memory KV caches and invalidate CDN caches if any derived content is cached.
- Stephanie: produce the erasure-manifest with: list of deleted paths, deletion timestamps, and SHA256 digests of the deleted objects prior to deletion (where possible). Put manifest + proof bundle in the Drive folder linked below.

Target SLA: complete execution and evidence handoff within 72 hours from acceptance (i.e., by 2026-10-15 11:00 UTC). If any blocker, escalate to me immediately.

Attachments: (none here).

On Tue, Oct 13, 2026 at 10:18 AM Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finexa.com> wrote:
> Hi Maya —
>
> Confirmed. finexa-eu-3 should be fully purged; no staging aliases. Our legal lead is Sara Novak (sara.novak@finexa.com). Can you share what proof looks like?
>
> Thanks,
> Tom
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finexa.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Completion: finexa-eu-3 prompt/output purge and evidence delivery (ERASE-457)

Hi Tom / Sara,

This is to confirm that we completed the purge for tenant finexa-eu-3. Summary of actions performed:
- Blob store sweep: removed object prefixes for finexa-eu-3 in eu-west-1 (buckets: rt-logs-finexa-eu-3, prompts-finexa-eu-3).
- Trace-store scrubbed: request/response traces older and newer were removed where tenant tag matched.
- KV cache: cache entries evicted and a flush run executed across serving nodes; cached shards were rotated.
- Model-layer ephemeral artifacts: any transient inference artifacts tied to the tenant were expunged where removable.

Evidence delivered: attached is the erasure bundle (erasure-manifest-20261014.zip) that contains:
- erasure-manifest.csv (deleted paths + timestamps + operator id)
- sha256_proofs.txt (pre-deletion digests for items we hashed)
- runbook-log.txt (ops run output with job ids)

Notes/Constraints:
- We cannot produce immutable forensic proof for tokenization-level internal model weights; for transparency we included runbook logs and object digests where applicable.
- If you require notarized signatures for the manifest we can coordinate with Legal and provide DocuSign on the artifact delivery.

If everything looks good to Finexa Legal, we'll close ERASE-457 and archive the evidence bundle to the secure retention folder. Let me know if you need additional artifacts or a formal attestation letter.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: erasure-manifest-20261014.zip
